mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ai_workflow_run WHERE status = 'RUNNING' AND started_at < #{cutoff} ORDER BY started_at ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_workflow_run SET status = 'FAILED', error_code = #{errorCode}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, duration_ms = GREATEST( 0, TIMESTAMPDIFF( MICROSECOND,started_at,#{finishedAt}) DIV 1000), finished_at = #{finishedAt} WHERE run_id = #{runId} AND status = 'RUNNING'
